description_en: Calls ModifyInstanceServiceConfig to modify cluster configurations. You can call the ListInstanceServiceConfigurations operation to query the configuration items that can be modified
description_zh: 调用ModifyInstanceServiceConfig更改集群配置，可修改的配置项可通过ListInstanceServiceConfigurations接口查看
kebab_example: aliyun hbase modify-instance-service-config --cluster-id hb-t4naqsay5gn0000 --restart false --configure-name 'hbase#hbase-site.xml#hbase.client.keyvalue.maxsize' --configure-value 10485770 --parameters key1=value1_,_key2=value2 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceServiceConfig

parameters.description_en: The ID of target instance. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~144595~~) operation to obtain target instance ID.
parameters.help_en: The ID of target instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html operation to obtain target instance ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to restart the instance after the configuration is modified. Valid values:

- **true**: Restart the instance.
- **false**: Do not restart the instance.
parameters.description_zh:
更改配置项后是否需要重启实例，取值：

- **true**：重启。
- **false**：不重启。
